Lena - AE: heads up — CipherLane wants a short POC to validate SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning (delta + bulk), RBAC mapping, and domain controls before legal signs. they need answers by Wed morning. who can drive tech Qs?

Diego - Solutions Eng: I can lead. main unknowns: how we handle delegated domain claims (DNS TXT vs. email verification), SCIM throughput limits during bulk syncs, and examples for role mapping to our API scopes.

Ivy - Security: i'll take the security questionnaire items. quick note: we require TLS1.2+ for SCIM and prefer mTLS for SCIM in Private deployments. also need to confirm our audit log retention policy for Dedicated customers.

Lena - AE: cipherlane's IA team also asked about SAML metadata rotation and support for encrypted assertions. can we support assertion encryption?

Diego - Solutions Eng: yes - SP supports encrypted assertions and metadata signing. rotation best practice: publish new metadata, keep old key active for 7 days overlap, test with idp. i'll include a sample in the response.

Diego - Solutions Eng: sample RBAC mapping snippet to paste into their IAM doc:
```
{
  "roles": [
    {"name":"PlatformAdmin","scopes":["model:deploy","billing:read","users:manage"]},
    {"name":"Compliance","scopes":["audit:read","logs:export"]},
    {"name":"Worker","scopes":["generate","embeddings:read"]}
  ]
}
```

Diego - Solutions Eng: SCIM defaults for POC (we recommend these for delta/bulk):
```
scim_defaults:
  delta_per_min: 250
  bulk_window_seconds: 1800
  acceptance_timeout: 30s
  support_mtls: true  # optional for Private
```

Ivy - Security: confirming: we can accept SAML idp-initiated flows, support signed/encrypted assertions, and our SP metadata can be signed. audit logs retained 90 days by default for Dedicated, extendable via add-on. KMS-backed key management available for Private.

Lena - AE: perfect. Mark, pricing? CipherLane asked for a 10-day Dedicated trial (2x A100 equiv) + optional hosted fallback for spikes. can we pro-rate?

Mark - Finance: short trials handled with daily pro-rate. 10 days, 2 GPUs list = $8,000, suggested trial discount 20% -> $6,400. add-on: 24/7 concierge support = $3,500 flat for trial. note: network egress billed separately per GB.

Ivy - Security: yes. please send QIDs. i'll add references to SOC2 sections and link to our SOC2 report stub for them.

Lena - AE: timeline: assemble responses today, send to CipherLane security by EOD PST, and include the estimate + ticket link. thanks all. :rocket:
